lines.text: The LORD tells Jacob and Israel not to fear, for He has redeemed them, and the flames will not set them ablaze.
The LORD gives Egypt, Cush and Seba as ransom for Israel because they are precious and He loves them.
God promises to bring His people from the east and gather them from the north, and He tells the south to give them up.
The nations are told to bring their witnesses, but the LORD says His own people are His witnesses and His chosen servant.
The LORD says there is no Savior but Him, and that He alone decreed, saved and proclaimed, not some golden god.
